_about: The onboarding every visitor sees on every arrival from outside the site, on the home page and /obavia.html: the ignition (Jason's portrait in a tachometer bezel, tap to start), one question, an optional name, a title card, then the cut that suits them. intro.js reads this; tools/site/assemble_home.py inlines it into both pages as #onboarding-data. Every line must be true and in llms.txt. No em dashes.
